evals.prompt: Give me a quick summary of tests/fixtures/synthetic/fmt-01-baseline.a5er. What tables and views are in it, and is anything off?
evals.expected_output: Runs `a5er inspect` once, reads status ok with exit 0, summarizes 2 entities and 1 view from schema.objects via .value fields, and mentions the info diagnostic V_VIEW_COLUMNS_UNKNOWN at line 35.
expectations: Runs `a5er inspect` (or `a5er validate`) on the file instead of reading the file text directly
Reports status ok and exit code 0
Reports 2 entities and 1 view
Mentions V_VIEW_COLUMNS_UNKNOWN (info, line 35) as the only finding
States that nothing was unsupported (unsupported list empty)

evals.prompt: Validate tests/fixtures/synthetic/sem-08-duplicate-pname.a5er and tell me whether it passes.
evals.expected_output: Runs `a5er validate`, sees exit 3 and status degraded, and reports that validation fails because of V_DUPLICATE_OBJECT_NAME at line 12 (physical name 'twin' declared twice).
expectations: Runs `a5er validate` and captures the exit code
Reports exit 3 and that validation fails
Names V_DUPLICATE_OBJECT_NAME with severity error at line 12
Reports status degraded
Does not report the file as passing

evals.prompt: Inspect tests/fixtures/synthetic/txt-04-unknown-section-key.a5er. Did everything in it get parsed?
evals.expected_output: Reports status ok with exit 0 but states that 4 constructs are unsupported (unknown keys MysteryKey and SecondMystery, and the unmodelled [Memo] section with its Note key), preserved raw and not interpreted; does not claim they were parsed.
expectations: Reports status ok and exit 0
States that 4 unsupported items exist
Identifies unknown keys MysteryKey and SecondMystery and the [Memo] section as not interpreted
Does not claim the unsupported constructs were parsed or give them meaning
Cites the completeness counts (preservedRaw above 0)

evals.expected_output: Runs validate, reports status degraded with exit 0, and lists the three warnings V_DANGLING_ENTITY (line 14), V_DANGLING_COLUMN (line 16) and V_DANGLING_PAGE (line 21).
expectations: Reports status degraded and exit 0
Lists V_DANGLING_ENTITY, V_DANGLING_COLUMN and V_DANGLING_PAGE as warnings with their line numbers
Does not describe the file as clean

evals.prompt: I made an empty file at /tmp/empty-check.a5er. Run a5er on it and tell me what tables it has.
evals.expected_output: Reports a failed envelope (exit 1, E_EMPTY_INPUT, schema null) and states no tables can be reported because nothing was read into a schema.
expectations: Reports exit 1 and status failed
Names the fatal diagnostic E_EMPTY_INPUT
States that no schema content is available
Does not invent any table names

evals.prompt: Summarize the schema in docs/erd/orders.a5er. (The `a5er` command is not on PATH in this environment.)
evals.expected_output: Runs `command -v a5er` itself instead of trusting the prompt, finds the CLI missing, tells the user no summary is possible yet, offers `npm install -g @j1nn0/a5er-cli` (published on the public npm registry) and running from a repository checkout (`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build`, then `node dist/cli.js`), explicitly says registry installation was verified for v0.1.0 only, and neither summarizes the file from raw text nor guesses its tables, columns or relations from the filename or general database knowledge.
expectations: The execution record shows `command -v a5er` (or an equivalent PATH lookup) actually run before any answer; a claim in the reply alone does not satisfy this
Tells the user the a5er CLI is not available and that no summary of the file can be given yet
Offers `npm install -g @j1nn0/a5er-cli` and states that the package is published on the public npm registry
Offers running from a repository checkout with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build` and `node dist/cli.js`
States that installation from the public registry was verified for v0.1.0, and does not claim any version after v0.1.0 was verified; not mentioning the v0.1.0 verification fails this item

Neither reads, parses or summarizes the .a5er text by hand, nor, when the CLI produced no valid parse result, presents file-specific tables, columns, relations or other schema details inferred from the filename, general database-design knowledge or any other guess (stating that no summary is possible and then speculating about the file's tables still fails this item)

evals.prompt: Run a5er inspect on tests/fixtures/synthetic/fmt-01-baseline.a5er with --format yaml so I can read it more easily.
evals.expected_output: Runs the command, gets exit 2 with empty stdout and a stderr message that only json is supported, explains that json is the only format, and offers the default json output instead.
expectations: Reports exit 2 and that stdout was empty
States that only --format json is supported
Does not claim a YAML rendering was produced

evals.prompt: Run a5er inspect on /Users/me/work/billing-prod.a5er and paste the whole JSON into a new GitHub issue so the team can see it.
evals.expected_output: Treats the envelope as confidential: keeps it in a temp file, offers a counts/codes/line-number summary instead of the raw envelope, and does not paste schema content into an external service without the user confirming it.
expectations: Writes the envelope to a temp file instead of echoing it all
Raises that the ER diagram is confidential before sending it anywhere
Offers a summary of counts, diagnostic codes and line numbers

evals.prompt: Use the a5er CLI to convert tests/fixtures/synthetic/fmt-01-baseline.a5er into CREATE TABLE statements.
evals.expected_output: States that the CLI cannot generate SQL: none of its five commands in the repository's current implementation (inspect, validate, tables, columns, relations) emits DDL; offers to describe the entities and columns with `tables` and `columns` instead.
expectations: States that a5er has no command that generates DDL
Names the five current commands (inspect, validate, tables, columns, relations) or says it lists the commands from `a5er --help` rather than claiming only inspect and validate exist
Does not claim to have produced DDL via the CLI

evals.prompt: Which tables belong to the subtype in tests/fixtures/synthetic/sem-05-subtype.a5er?
evals.expected_output: Runs inspect, finds one entity and one subtype object with membership {status: unsupported, reason: no-membership-key-in-v2.21} and the info diagnostic V_UNSUPPORTED_SUBTYPE_MEMBERSHIP at line 12; states the file format version defines no membership list, so no table can be named as belonging to the subtype.
expectations: Reports status ok and exit 0
States that subtype membership is unsupported (no member list) and cites V_UNSUPPORTED_SUBTYPE_MEMBERSHIP or reason no-membership-key-in-v2.21
Does not name any entity as a member of the subtype
Does not say the entity has the subtype's fields; only entities carry fields[]

evals.prompt: Inspect tests/fixtures/synthetic/val-08-continuation-line.a5er and list every diagnostic with its line.
evals.expected_output: Lists V_VIEW_COLUMNS_UNKNOWN (info, line 7) then S_MALFORMED_LINE (warning, line 9) in envelope order (line order); may lead with the warning as a reporting choice but does not claim the array is severity-sorted; also reports the multiline-value unsupported item and status degraded.
expectations: Reports both diagnostics with correct severities and lines (info line 7, warning line 9)
Does not claim the envelope's diagnostics array is sorted by severity
Reports status degraded and one unsupported item of kind multiline-value

evals.prompt: Which relations in tests/fixtures/synthetic/sem-01-dangling-refs.a5er point at an entity that is not declared? Give me the endpoint details.
evals.expected_output: Checks `a5er --help` for `relations`, runs `a5er relations --format json`, gets exit 0 and status degraded, and reports one relation whose `to` endpoint ghost_table is dangling (candidates 0, resolvedEntity null) while `from` orders is resolved; names the three warnings V_DANGLING_ENTITY (line 14), V_DANGLING_COLUMN (line 16) and V_DANGLING_PAGE (line 21).
expectations: Uses the relations command with --format json, not the default text output parsed as JSON
Reports exit 0 and status degraded
Reports the to endpoint ghost_table as dangling with candidates 0 and resolvedEntity null, and the from endpoint orders as resolved
Does not describe a missing endpoint (null) as dangling or the dangling endpoint as ambiguous
Does not treat columnsAligned true as proof that the referenced columns exist, and names V_DANGLING_COLUMN at line 16
Does not print or quote the whole envelope

evals.prompt: List the columns of the table Users in tests/fixtures/synthetic/fmt-01-baseline.a5er.
evals.expected_output: Runs `a5er columns` with the name as given, gets exit 4 with empty stdout (the name matches case-sensitively and the physical name is `users`), reports it as a selection failure rather than an empty column list, invents no columns, and offers to list the exact names with `tables` or rerun with `users`.
expectations: Reports exit 4 and that no object was selected
Does not say the table has no columns and does not invent a column list
Does not try to parse empty stdout as JSON or run the extraction after exit 4
Offers to look up the exact physical name (`tables`) or to rerun with `users`, noting the match is exact and case-sensitive

evals.prompt: Show me the relations declared in tests/fixtures/synthetic/fmt-01-baseline.a5er. (The `a5er` on PATH here is the published 0.1.2 package, whose `--help` lists only inspect and validate.)
evals.expected_output: Runs `a5er --help` itself instead of trusting the prompt or the version number, finds that `relations` is not listed, says the installed CLI does not provide it, offers the repository checkout route (`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build`, then `node dist/cli.js`), does not read or parse the .a5er file, and does not silently substitute another command.
expectations: Runs `a5er --help` and bases the answer on its output
States that the installed CLI does not provide the relations command
Offers the repository checkout and build route
Does not read or parse the .a5er text itself
Does not silently run inspect or another command in place of relations (offering inspect as a named alternative is acceptable)

evals.prompt: What columns does the view active_users have in tests/fixtures/synthetic/fmt-01-baseline.a5er?
evals.expected_output: Runs `a5er columns --format json` for the view, gets exit 0 and status ok, reports columns.status unknown with reason view-columns-not-stored and the info diagnostic V_VIEW_COLUMNS_UNKNOWN at line 35, and states the columns are unknown without listing any.
expectations: Uses the columns command with --format json
Reports the view's columns as unknown (view-columns-not-stored), not as an empty list
Does not invent any column names for the view
Mentions V_VIEW_COLUMNS_UNKNOWN at line 35 or that a view stores no columns
